title: Write amplification during batch invoice processing
comments: We ran tests with pg_partman and native range partitioning. Evan pointed out that row-level TTL deletion was saturating our WAL replication bandwidth. After benching both on staging, we agreed to partition the audit_events table by month starting next sprint rather than keeping the monolith table with cron deletions.

title: Intermittent ingress timeout during cluster autoscaler scaling events
comments: Investigated the 504 errors during node pool spinup. Graceful shutdown preStop hooks were set to 15s which wasn't enough for drain operations. Bob reviewed the envoy proxy access logs and concluded that increasing the preStop sleep hook to 45 seconds across all ingress deployments prevents dropping active TCP connections.

title: Memory fragmentation and latency spikes in cluster node 3
comments: Our earlier approach was using jemalloc background threads for memory defragmentation, but under sustained write workloads this caused latency spikes above 20ms. Ian Malcolm and Kevin concluded we must revert jemalloc background thread defragmentation in favor of scheduled rolling node restarts during off-peak maintenance windows.
